actors.name: Sunmark housing cooperative board
actors.private_context: The board has called a special general meeting for the 12th to vote on amending the pet policy. They need at least two-thirds of members to turn out for the amendment to pass. They have sent out notices and are hoping for high attendance.

actors.name: Sunmark housing cooperative members
actors.private_context: Members have received notice of the special general meeting on the 12th regarding the pet policy amendment. Each member has their own schedule, interest in the issue, and likelihood of attending. Some may be in favor of the amendment, some opposed, and some indifferent.

shared_context: The Sunmark housing cooperative's bylaws require a two-thirds member turnout to amend the pet policy. A special general meeting has been called for the 12th to vote on this amendment. The meeting will be held at the cooperative's community hall. Members have been notified via email and posted notices.

starting_events.description: The board has sent out notices for the special general meeting on the 12th to amend the pet policy.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least two-thirds of the cooperative's members actually attended (or were represented by proxy, if allowed) the special general meeting on the 12th. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
